limits: Virtual devices and disposable owned x64/x86 targets only. No hardware/RustDesk input used for control or validation; no OS input injection.

Native window message processing proves delivered axis/delta/coordinates/modifiers; no general application horizontal scrolling compatibility claim.

Unsupported fixed-mode rejection, invalid HWND/PID and out-of-signed16 helper boundaries are producer/source checks, not independent live cases. No display arrangement changes or beyond-signed16 native test.
